subject.name: Pathologists
subject.summary: Pathologists (United States SOC 29-1222) diagnose disease through tissue, cell, and body fluid specimens, produce pathology reports, and explain findings to clinicians. Core work includes verifying specimen identity and the clinical question, selecting appropriate tests, recognizing abnormalities, reviewing conclusions, and communicating critical results promptly. The procedure and signing scope of different subspecialties is determined by medical training, state licensure, and institutional authorization. The United States wage and employment figures on this page correspond only to the 29-1222 statistical row, and Chinese physician qualification and wages require separate verification.
